decisions.statement: A taboo term is keyed by the word the taboo term bars.
The word is written wherever the word has a sense the term does not bar.
A term names the senses the term keeps as well as the senses the term bars.
A term naming no kept sense permits every other sense by omission alone.
A sense a term bars was written here before the sense was barred.
A taboo term is found by its pattern rather than by its slug.
A taboo term states no warrant for what the taboo term bars.
A change adding text a pattern finds is refused until that term has been read.
A term reaches inside a camelCase name.
A change is judged for a term over the whole body it writes rather than the part it changes.

definition: a word this system never writes in the senses it bars
